content.thinking: Now more capture tests: line limits, block limits, chunked edge cases, error offsets, committed, owners/flags, budgets, compressed huge captures.

content.text: Now line/block limits, chunk-size rules, error offsets, and `committed` semantics:

arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/tests/test_capture2.py << 'EOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from harness import *

def doc(cases, events, channels, definitions=None, timeout_ms=10, seed='s'):
    return {'seed': seed, 'definitions': definitions or [], 'timeout_ms': timeout_ms,
            'cases': cases, 'events': events, 'channels': channels}

def case(name, frames=None, method='GET', target='/a', host='h'):
    return {'name': name, 'frames': frames or [],
            'expect': {'method': method, 'target': target, 'host': host}}

def hf(pairs, end=True):
    return {'Type': 'headers', 'data_to_transfered': [[k, v] for k, v in pairs], 'End_Stream': end}

def chan(name, parts):
    return {'name': name, 'parts': [{'case': o, 'data': d} for o, d in parts]}

def parse(parts, cases=None):
    r = run_obj(doc(cases or [case('c', [hf([('x','y')])])], [], [chan('z', parts)]))
    return r

def err_of(parts):
    r = parse(parts)
    return r['channels'][0]['error']

# ---- D. line limits -----------------------------------------------------
big8190 = "GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\nX:" + "a"*8190 + "\r\n\r\n"       # header content 8192
big8191 = "GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\nX:" + "a"*8191 + "\r\n\r\n"       # header content 8193
check('line content 8192 ok', err_of([(None, big8190)]) is None)
e = err_of([(None, big8191)])
check('line content 8193 syntax', e == {'kind': 'syntax', 'offset': 0}, e)
check('8193 bytes no LF incomplete', err_of([(None, "X" * 8193)]) == {'kind': 'incomplete', 'offset': 0})
check('8194 bytes no LF syntax', err_of([(None, "X" * 8194)]) == {'kind': 'syntax', 'offset': 0})
# request line of content 8192 (via long target) is ok
long_target = "GET /" + "a"*8185 + " HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n"            # content 8192
check('long request line ok', err_of([(None, long_target)]) is None)

# ---- E. block limits -----------------------------------------------------
field = "X:" + "a"*7998 + "\r\n"    # 8002 bytes per line
r = parse([(None, "GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\n" + field*8 + "\r\n")])
check('block 8 fat fields ok', r['channels'][0]['error'] is None and len(r['channels'][0]['requests']) == 1)
e = err_of([(None, "GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\n" + field*9 + "\r\n")])
check('block over 65536 syntax', e == {'kind': 'syntax', 'offset': 0}, e)
small = "X: a\r\n"
r = parse([(None, "GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\n" + small*128 + "\r\n")])
check('128 fields ok', r['channels'][0]['error'] is None)
e = err_of([(None, "GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\n" + small*129 + "\r\n")])
check('129 fields syntax', e == {'kind': 'syntax', 'offset': 0}, e)

# ---- F. chunk-size line rules --------------------------------------------
def chunked(chunks_and_tail):
    return "POST /u HTTP/1.1\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n" + chunks_and_tail

ok_body = "5\r\nhello\r\n0\r\n\r\n"
r = parse([(None, chunked(ok_body))])
rec = r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
check('simple chunked ok', rec['body'] == fp(b'hello') and r['channels'][0]['error'] is None)

for name, tail, expect in [
    ('hex case', "A\r\n" + "z"*10 + "\r\n0\r\n\r\n", ('ok', b'z'*10)),
    ('leading zeros', "0005\r\nhello\r\n0\r\n\r\n", ('ok', b'hello')),
    ('empty suffix', "5;\r\nhello\r\n0\r\n\r\n", ('ok', b'hello')),
    ('suffix chars', "5;a b\tc\r\nhello\r\n0\r\n\r\n", ('ok', b'hello')),
    ('zero with suffix', "5\r\nhello\r\n0;x\r\n\r\n", ('ok', b'hello')),
    ('whitespace in size', "5 ;x\r\nhello\r\n0\r\n\r\n", ('syntax', None)),
    ('0x junk', "0x5\r\n", ('syntax', None)),
    ('empty size line', "\r\n", ('syntax', None)),
    ('bad suffix char', "5;\x01\r\nhello\r\n0\r\n\r\n", ('syntax', None)),
    ('size too large', "10000000000000000\r\n", ('syntax', None)),
    ('size max legal', "7fffffffffffffff\r\n", ('incomplete', None)),
    ('bad chunk terminator', "5\r\nhelloXY0\r\n\r\n", ('syntax', None)),
    ('missing chunk data', "5\r\nhel", ('incomplete', None)),
    ('missing chunk crlf', "5\r\nhello", ('incomplete', None)),
    ('unfinished size line', "5", ('incomplete', None)),
]:
    r = parse([(None, chunked(tail))])
    ch = r['channels'][0]
    if expect[0] == 'ok':
        got = ('ok', ch['requests'][0]['body'] == fp(expect[1]))
        check('chunk ' + name, got == ('ok', True) and ch['error'] is None, (got, ch['error']))
    else:
        e = ch['error']
        check('chunk ' + name, e == {'kind': expect[0], 'offset': 0}, e)

# trailer rules
r = parse([(None, chunked("0\r\nX-T: v\r\nX-T: w\r\n\r\n"))])
rec = r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
check('trailer duplicates preserved', rec['trailers'] == fp(enc_pairs([(b'X-T', b'v'), (b'X-T', b'w')])), rec['trailers'])
for tname, tblock in [('trailer Host', "0\r\nHost: x\r\n\r\n"),
                      ('trailer host lower', "0\r\nhost: x\r\n\r\n"),
                      ('trailer CL', "0\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n"),
                      ('trailer TE', "0\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n"),
                      ('trailer bad field', "0\r\nXY\r\n\r\n")]:
    e = err_of([(None, chunked(tblock))])
    check(tname, e == {'kind': 'syntax', 'offset': 0}, e)
r = parse([(None, chunked("0\r\n" + "X: a\r\n"*128 + "\r\n"))])
check('128 trailer fields ok', r['channels'][0]['error'] is None)
e = err_of([(None, chunked("0\r\n" + "X: a\r\n"*129 + "\r\n"))])
check('129 trailer fields syntax', e == {'kind': 'syntax', 'offset': 0}, e)
big_t = "X:" + "a"*7998 + "\r\n"
e = err_of([(None, chunked("0\r\n" + big_t*9 + "\r\n"))))
check('trailer block over limit syntax', e == {'kind': 'syntax', 'offset': 0}, e)
e = err_of([(None, chunked("0\r\nX: a\r\n"))])
check('unfinished trailer incomplete', e == {'kind': 'incomplete', 'offset': 0}, e)

# ---- G/H. opaque bodies, offsets, committed -------------------------------
fake = "GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n"
tail = "POST /b HTTP/1.1\r\nContent-Length: " + str(len(fake)) + "\r\n\r\n" + fake
second = "GET /c HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\n\r\n"
r = parse([(None, tail + second)])
ch = r['channels'][0]
check('opaque body no split', ch['error'] is None and len(ch['requests']) == 2)
check('opaque body bytes', ch['requests'][0]['body'] == fp(fake.encode()), ch['requests'][0]['body'])
check('second offset', ch['requests'][1]['start'] == len(tail))
check('committed one part', ch['committed'] == [2], ch['committed'])

r = parse([(None, "GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n"), (None, "BAD"), (None, "GET /b HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n")])
ch = r['channels'][0]
check('syntax offset mid stream', ch['error'] == {'kind': 'syntax', 'offset': 18}, ch['error'])
check('committed stops at error', ch['committed'] == [1, 1, 1], ch['committed'])
check('only earlier records', len(ch['requests']) == 1)

r = parse([(None, "GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n"), (None, "GET /b HTTP/1.1\r\n")])
ch = r['channels'][0]
check('incomplete offset', ch['error'] == {'kind': 'incomplete', 'offset': 18}, ch['error'])

r = parse([(None, "GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n")])
check('fully consumed null error', r['channels'][0]['error'] is None)
r = parse([])
check('empty channel', r['channels'][0]['error'] is None and r['channels'][0]['requests'] == [] and
      r['channels'][0]['committed'] == [] and r['channels'][0]['bytes'] == fp(b''))
r = parse([(None, "")])
check('zero-length part', r['channels'][0]['error'] is None and r['channels'][0]['committed'] == [0])

# committed across parts spanning requests
p0 = "GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\nHo"
p1 = "st: h\r\n\r\n"
p2 = "GET /b HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\n\r\n"
p3 = ""
r = parse([(None, p0), (None, p1), (None, p2), (None, p3)])
ch = r['channels'][0]
check('committed multi-part', ch['committed'] == [0, 1, 2, 2], ch['committed'])
check('two requests parsed', len(ch['requests']) == 2 and ch['requests'][1]['start'] == len(p0)+len(p1))

summary()
EOF
cd /workspace && python3 tests/test_capture2.py
